editorial:
Imagine a cozy retirement village where the residents don't just play bingo and nap. Instead, you get a crew of four seniors who spend their Thursdays digging into old police files to solve cold cases for fun. It is a total blast to watch these unlikely friends use their life experience to outsmart the actual police. The vibe is warm, funny, and feels like a big hug, but it still keeps you guessing with a real murder that happens right in their own backyard. You will love how the group dynamics work, as each person brings a different skill to the table, from nursing knowledge to old-school spy tricks.

The acting is top-notch and makes the characters feel like people you actually know. While the plot moves a bit slow in the middle, the big twists at the end make it worth the wait. If you enjoy lighthearted mysteries that don't take themselves too seriously, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out that the murder was actually a cover-up for a decades-old crime involving a local developer. The twist is that the killer was someone the group trusted, who tried to hide the evidence of a past accident. The seniors use a clever trap to trick the villain into confessing everything in front of the police. In the end, the group celebrates their victory with tea and cake, ready for their next case.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good whodunit and heartwarming friendships.
